name: ecr-image-not-found
title: An ECS deployment attempted to use a missing image
description: An ECS deployment or redeployment attempted to pull an image tag that does not exist in ECR.
investigation_steps: Review the matching CloudTrail event or failing ECS task to identify the missing image tag.
Check that the expected image was successfully built and pushed to ECR and is available in the repository.
This may cause downtime if not resolved promptly, try rebuilding the image with the pipeline and ensure prod is using the correct image tag.
Check production, as this might have already caused downtime if there is no healthy container running.

query: fields @timestamp, eventSource, eventName, errorCode, requestParameters.repositoryName, requestParameters.imageIds, responseElements.failures
